candidates.articleTextExcerpt: Assam to Get India’s First Underwater Road-Cum-Rail Tunnel Under Brahmaputra Assam’s ₹18,662-crore Gohpur-Numaligarh corridor includes India’s first underwater road-cum-rail tunnel beneath the Brahmaputra River. article.articleTextExcerpt: The Union Government has launched India’s first Liquified Natural Gas (LNG) powered diesel electric multiple unit (DEMU) train with eight coaches from Sabarmati railway station to Mahesana Junction in Gujarat as part of its green initiatives on September 27, 2026. The train is based on a diesel-LNG dual fuel system for operating its driving power cars (DPCs) on both diesel and LNG. This system lets LNG to substitute for about 40 per cent of diesel usage and a full tank of LNG can operate for around 1,600 km. Moreover, two DPCs with each having 1,400 horsepower (hp) of capacity has been transformed to function using this dual fuel system with LNG tank attached to each for holding 2,200 litres of LNG. Besides, field trials for these two DPCs have also been conducted on over 2,000 km to check its reliability.

article.title: ‘Party of jokers’: BJP hits out at Congress over PM Modi mimicry at Rahul Gandhi’s Indore event
article.description: Union Minister Piyush Goyal says, The need to come on stage every now and then just to drag Prime Minister Modi jis name into cheap political theatre never fails to amaze me
article.articleTextExcerpt: The BJP on Sunday said that the Congress had turned into a "circus" and called Rahul Gandhi "asanskari naraz fufa" after a stand-up comedian performed mimicry of Prime Minister Narendra Modi at an event of the opposition leader in Madhya Pradesh. In the video shared by the Congress on X, stand-up comedian Pulkit Mani was seen mimicking Prime Minister Modi while performing a skit with Gandhi during the latest edition of the 'chatron ki goonj' event in Indore on Saturday. In the short act, Mani came on stage laughing and hugged Gandhi. "My friend. How are you?" To this, Gandhi replied, "I'm fine; how are you, Modi ji?" Mani responded, "Great harassment", and continued laughing while using the phrase "my friend". Gandhi then said, "Very nice to meet you," and asked Mani to "tell me more". article.title: Pune gets AI-powered building diagnostic
article.description: Pune gets an AI-powered building diagnostic centre focused on technology-driven inspection, early detection and preventive maintenance.
article.articleTextExcerpt: Griha Sanjivan Foundation, in partnership with Foxscan, has launched a Building Diagnostic Experience Centre in Pune, a non-profit initiative aimed at strengthening the use of technology and data in building inspection, diagnosis and maintenance. The initiative focuses on making building diagnosis more Accurate, Accessible, Affordable and Practical (AAAP), while creating opportunities for skill development among contractors, civil professionals, painters and building-maintenance personnel. The Experience Centre has been developed to demonstrate how technology-led diagnostic methods can help identify building-related issues at an early stage and support more informed maintenance decisions. “The industry has no shortage of chemical and paint products. The real gap is consistent diagnosis. Foxscan is building that missing intelligence layer by combining purpose-built hardware, AI, software and data from more than 40,000 inspected properties. needsReviewNews.articleTextExcerpt: काम की बात: दिल्ली से गुरुग्राम आना-जाना होगा आसान, एलिवेटेड सड़क बनाएगी NHAIOct 02, 2026 05:53 am ISTBy Subodh Kumar Mishra हिन्दुस्तान, गुरुग्राम दिल्ली से गुरुग्राम का सफर आसान होने वाला है। अंधेरिया मोड़ से लेकर दिल्ली-गुरुग्राम बॉर्डर तक करीब साढ़े आठ किलोमीटर लंबी सड़क बनाई जाएगी। इसमें दिल्ली के हिस्से में आने वाली साढ़े चार किलोमीटर सड़क को एलिवेटेड बनाया जाएगा। गुरुग्राम-दिल्ली के बीच एलिवेटेड रोड बनेगा।दिल्ली से गुरुग्राम आने-जाने वाले लोगों के लिए अच्छी खबर है। भारतीय राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण (एनएचएआई) ने गुरुग्राम और दिल्ली के बीच यातायात बेहतर करने के लिए कदम बढ़ाए हैं। जल्द दिल्ली के हिस्से में साढ़े चार किलोमीटर लंबा एलिवेटेड रोड बनाया जाएगा। गुरुग्राम के हिस्से में आने वाली सड़क की डीपीआर तैयार करने के लिए एक सलाहकार कंपनी को भी नियुक्त कर दिया गया है।गुरुग्राम में दिल्ली-जयपुर हाईवे स्थित इफको चौक से एमजी रोड शुरू होता है, जो दिल्ली के अंधेरिया मोड़ तक है। एनएचएआई ने अंधेरिया मोड़ से लेकर दिल्ली-गुरुग्राम बॉर्डर तक करीब साढ़े आठ किलोमीटर लंबी रोड में से साढ़े चार किलोमीटर में एलिवेटेड रोड के निर्माण की डीपीआर तैयार कर ली है। एमजी रोड को चौड़ा करने की योजना भी इस डीपीआर का हिस्सा है। इस योजना पर 980 करोड़ रुपये की लागत आएगी। तकनीकी तौर पर इस डीपीआर को मंजूरी मिल
